description: Lists the design-system packs polyxd_show can draw a screen in: published design systems (Material 3, Carbon, GOV.UK and others) and original templates. The same document looks native in each.
name: polyxd_packs

default.description: The pack polyxd_show uses when none is given.

description.description: A one-line description of the pack.

displayName.description: The name to show people, e.g. "IBM Carbon".

name.description: The pack's name: the value to pass as polyxd_show's "pack".

package.description: The npm package with the pack's design tokens.

template.description: True for an original template to start from; false for a published design system.

title: List Polyxd packs
